rows.title: End-to-end proof: a germinal products notification for bovine semen, from create to submitted
rows.detail: Every whole journey the tests walk today is a live animals one, so nothing proves the germinal products set end to end. A germinal products notification starts on its own origin page, with no notification type question, and runs through its own opening run: it has no Additional details step, keeps each species' total gross weight on Commodity details, and asks Transit countries only for rail or road. This row walks a bovine semen notification through that run in the animals test project, checks the overview once every task is done, checks the review shows the answers given and checks the confirmation shows the reference.
acceptanceCriteria: A spec in the animals test project's germinal products folder, under tests/animals/e2e/germinal-products, walks a germinal products notification for bovine semen from create to submitted, travelling by road. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-062; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-005; repo:tests repo-tests-p8-152)

Starting a germinal products notification from the germinal products set opens the 'Origin of the import' page straight away, with no notification type question before it. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-004; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p6-003; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-009)

From the origin page onward the walked notification is a germinal products one: its review shows 'Certified for' reading 'Germinal products'. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-004; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-011)

In the road walk, 'Save and continue' takes the notification through 'Origin of the import', 'What are you importing?', 'Main import reason', 'Commodity details', 'Identification details', 'Arrival details', 'Transit countries', 'Transport details', 'Upload documents' and 'Consignment addresses', in that order. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-005; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p6-022; ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-004)

In the walk the total gross weight is entered in the bovine semen species block on 'Commodity details', with the species' quantity and number of packages, and 'Save and continue' there opens 'Identification details'. (ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-004; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p6-019)

In the walk 'Save and continue' on a valid 'Identification details' page opens 'Arrival details'. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-006; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p6-030)

Once every task is done, the notification's overview lists 'Commodity details' then 'Identification details' in its goods section, and 'Arrival details', 'Transit countries' then 'Transport details' in its transport and arrival section, each reading 'Complete'. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-006; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p6-030; ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-004)

Before declaring, the walk checks the review page shows each answer it gave, the total gross weight against the bovine semen species included. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-005; ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-004)

Ticking the declaration and continuing submits the notification and opens 'Import notification submitted', a confirmation panel showing 'Your reference number' and the notification's reference. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-046; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-062)
The walk runs in the animals test project under its existing browser configuration, with no new test project added. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-062; repo:tests repo-tests-p8-152)
rows.notes: Combines three whole-journey slices that share one germinal walk: the germinal start on its origin page (req-2902), the germinal opening run and completed overview (req-2903) and the bovine semen walk to submitted (req-2917). This area's share of existing row inc-184, which also holds req-1899 from the germinal-products area; the combiner keeps inc-184's id, theme germinal-products, repos and dependsOn. req-2903's statement still names a Total gross weight step and overview row; c-461 and c-486, both settled by precedence on the 27 November ruling, keep the weight per species on Commodity details with no separate page and no overview row, so the criteria follow them and inc-184's open question on c-461 is dropped as settled. 'Labelled Germinal products' is read as the certified-for value every germinal draft carries from creation. A proof row, tests only: the pages it walks are built by the germinal rows it depends on, so it is observable once they land, locally and in CI. The tests folders it creates do not exist yet and fall in no split-off theme's touches.
